But I didn't know it at the time.|Teza Nasz and Poe Dameron|}} '''Teza Nasz''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] individual who served as an [[officer]] in the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Navy|naval forces]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. At the [[Battle of Jakku]], she served as a strategist aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Ravager]]''. She survived the battle, and became a [[warlord]] on [[Rattatak]]. During the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the Empire's successor, the [[First Order]], and the [[Resistance]], Nasz was recruited into the latter by the Resistance's [[Resistance Starfighter Corps|Starfighter Corps]]. Later, she operated under [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] as a member of [[Corellian Team Two]]. During her time with the Resistance, Nasz flew a [[BTA-NR2 Y-wing starfighter]].{{FFGXW2|set=BTA-NR2 Y-Wing Expansion Pack|cardname=Teza Nasz}} {{Char-stub}} ==Appearances== [[File:TezaNaszHelmetTROSVD.png|thumb|right|250px|Nasz's [[flight helmet]]]] *''[[Resistance Reborn]]'' {{Ab|Resistance Reborn (audiobook)}} {{1st}} *{{Film|IX}} {{1stp}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' *{{FFGXW2|set=BTA-NR2 Y-Wing Expansion Pack|cardname=Teza Nasz}} *''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Teza Nasz |fr=Teza Nasz |ja=テザ・ナツ |ka=ტიზა ნაჟი }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Nasz, Teza}} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Navy officers of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:Resistance members]] [[Category:Warlords]]
